records.purpose: Check whether counting is based on number-sequence structure rather than reciting from 1.
records.use_when: Early number work or when pupils lose track across a multiple of ten.
records.setup: Write 47 on the board; no materials required.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 从47开始向前数8个数，再从55开始向后数8个数。跨过整十时发生了什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Start at 47 and count on 8 numbers. Then start at 55 and count back 8 numbers. What happens when you cross a multiple of ten?
records.expected_thinking: The sequence continues consistently from any starting point; decade boundaries change the tens digit without restarting the count.
records.listen_for: Restarting from 1; skipping 49/50 or 50/49; treating 50 as a break in the sequence.
records.evidence_note: Counting from arbitrary numbers is explicit in England/Common Core progression; use as a teaching option in a Chinese lesson.

records.purpose: Connect numeral recognition to quantity and position.
records.use_when: After pupils can read a numeral but before assuming place-value understanding is secure.
records.setup: Choose a two- or three-digit number; provide place-value materials or a quick sketch and a number line.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 把这个数用数字、位值学具和数轴位置表示。三个表示中，什么没有变？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Show this number as a numeral, with place-value materials, and on a number line. What stays the same across the three representations?
records.expected_thinking: The quantity remains invariant while the representation changes.
records.listen_for: Reading digits correctly but building the wrong quantity; inability to locate approximate magnitude on a number line.
records.variation: Change one digit and ask what must change in each representation.

records.purpose: Show that numbers can be decomposed in different ways for different calculations.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 47可以怎样分？对47+19和47+30，哪一种分法最有用？为什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: How can 47 be decomposed? Which decomposition is most useful for 47+19 and for 47+30? Why?
records.expected_thinking: Decomposition is flexible and chosen to expose a useful calculation structure.
records.listen_for: Belief that 40+7 is the only valid decomposition; choosing a decomposition without connecting it to the operation.

records.title_en: Move one place: how does the value change?
records.purpose: Make the multiplicative relationship between adjacent base-ten places explicit.
records.use_when: Whole-number place value, decimals or before written algorithms.
records.setup: Place a digit card 5 in the hundreds column of a place-value chart.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 这个5现在表示多少？向右移动一位后表示多少？数值发生了什么变化？
records.teacher_prompt_en: What is the value of the 5 now? Move it one place to the right. What is its value now? How did the value change?
records.expected_thinking: Moving one place right divides the place value by 10; moving left multiplies it by 10.
records.listen_for: Saying the digit is still worth 5; describing only the column name without the multiplicative relationship.

records.purpose: Connect number comparison to magnitude rather than visible digit size.
records.use_when: When pupils use unreliable digit-by-digit comparison rules.
records.setup: Draw an open number line from 0 to 120; use 95 and 103.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 95和103哪个更大？先把两个数大致放在数轴上，再说明你比较了哪个数位。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which is greater, 95 or 103? First place both approximately on the number line, then explain which place value you compared.
records.expected_thinking: 103 is greater because it contains one hundred; its number-line position confirms the magnitude.
records.listen_for: 95 is greater because 9>1; placing 95 to the right of 103.

records.title_en: Find the two bounding numbers first
records.purpose: Explain rounding through magnitude and midpoint rather than a digit rule alone.
records.setup: Open number line from 300 to 400; mark 350.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 347在哪两个整百之间？中点在哪里？所以347更接近哪一个整百？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which two hundreds is 347 between? Where is the midpoint? Which hundred is 347 closer to?
records.expected_thinking: Rounding compares distance to bounding multiples using the midpoint as a decision boundary.
records.listen_for: Applying a remembered next-digit rule without knowing the two candidates; incorrect midpoint.
records.variation: Use 350 and discuss the agreed rounding convention after magnitude is understood.

records.purpose: Establish order and distance for negative numbers using context and a number line.
records.use_when: China Grade 5-6 contextual extension or comparison with England/Common Core signed-number progression.
records.setup: Number line from -10 to 10; temperature context optional.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: -3和-8哪个更大？哪个离0更近？请在数轴上说明。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which is greater, -3 or -8? Which is closer to zero? Explain on the number line.
records.expected_thinking: Numbers farther right are greater; -3 is greater and closer to zero than -8.
records.listen_for: Applying positive-number magnitude ordering directly: 8>3 so -8>-3.
records.evidence_note: China primary evidence is a contextual integrated-practice treatment rather than a full primary negative-number arithmetic strand.
